questions.question: The underlined word "he" in paragraph 1 refers to ...............
The underlined word "traverse" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to ...............
According to paragraph 2, which of the following shows the correct chronological order of events?
choices: 1) The crew shoveling 600 tons of ice in order to take off after Amundsen and Omdal trying to fly to Spitsbergen for the first time
2) Amundsen and Ellsworth trying to reach the North Pole by air after the group, led by Umberto Nobile, landing in Alaska
3) Amundsen and 15 other men crossing the Arctic by Norge before Amundsen deciding to go on an aerial North Pole expedition
4) Nobile making the first crossing of the Arctic in Norge before Amundsen and his Norwegian companion's first aerial North Pole expedition failing

questions.question: All of the following words are mentioned in the passage EXCEPT ...............
According to the passage, which of the following statements is true?
choices: 1) Roald Amundsen was born into a family with little background in sea trade.
2) Until 1920, no man had successfully reached both geographical poles on record.
3) On his way to the Northwest Passage, Amundsen collected lots of money from local people.
4) Amundsen and Omdal managed to successfully fly to Spitsbergen in their first attempt.
